name: Grouping similar things without being told how
gist: Papers use clustering and prototype learning to organize data into meaningful groups by discovering natural patterns, without relying on human-provided category labels.
explain: Humans naturally cluster things: we recognize that apples and oranges are both fruits, or that a bicycle and a skateboard are both personal transport. Computers don't have this intuition. Clustering — grouping similar items without being told the categories upfront — is a fundamental task. Many real datasets have natural structure: similar documents cluster together, customer purchase behaviors group into profiles, proteins fold into families. If a model can discover these clusters without labels, it captures something real about the data's structure.

The challenge is defining 'similar' and 'cluster' without human guidance. Local clustering (grouping nearby points) is easy but fragile. Deep clustering tries to learn representations where clusters emerge naturally, but the model can collapse into trivial solutions: putting everything in one cluster, or creating many micro-clusters that do not reflect true structure. Papers use prototype learning (learn a set of cluster centers that represent the data) combined with self-supervised learning: the model compares each sample to prototypes, assigning it to the closest one, and simultaneously learns representations that make clusters more crisp. Some methods use consistency: if you apply different augmentations (slight changes) to the same image, the model should assign both to the same cluster.

Across 33 papers, researchers develop clustering objectives that avoid collapse, study how many clusters naturally exist in different datasets, and explore whether unsupervised clusters align with human-defined categories. Papers also ask how to update clusters over time as new data arrives, and how to handle data where there are many equally valid clusterings (e.g., images could be grouped by object type, color, or photographer style). The practical applications are strong: unsupervised data exploration, anomaly detection (points far from all clusters), and bootstrapping labels for downstream tasks.

papers.title: Aligning Collaborative View Recovery and Tensorial Subspace Learning via Latent Representation for Incomplete Multi-View Clustering
papers.contribution: ARSL-IMVC demonstrates powerful capacity in complex incomplete multi-view clustering tasks across seven datasets.

papers.title: Alleviating Observation Bias via Causal-Invariant Meta-Learning for Unbalanced Incomplete Multi-view Clustering
papers.contribution: Effectively alleviates observation bias for unbalanced incomplete multi-view clustering.

papers.title: Bures Generalized Category Discovery
papers.contribution: Improves cluster separability and class-number estimation by restoring token manifold geometry rather than compressing it, consistently boosting GCD baselines on coarse and fine-grained benchmarks.

papers.title: CURE: Consistency-under-Unified Semantic Regularization for Generalized Category Discovery
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance and substantially reduces the gap between known and novel category performance.

papers.title: Federated Multi-view Clustering for Remote Sensing Data
papers.contribution: Achieves superior clustering performance and efficiency with communication efficiency and privacy preservation on remote sensing benchmarks.

papers.title: Masked Multi-path Contrast with Confidence-Gated Semantic Imputation for Incomplete Multi-view Clustering
papers.contribution: Shows consistent gains over prior methods across benchmarks with different missing ratios through masked consensus and confidence-aware imputation.

papers.title: Multi-Scale Diffusion-Guided Graph Learning with Power-Smoothing Random Walk Contrast for Multi-View Clustering
papers.contribution: Extensive experiments on 12 benchmarks demonstrate improved performance by reconciling consistency-specificity trade-offs through diffusion-guided graph learning.

papers.title: Uncover Underlying Correspondence for Robust Multi-view Clustering
papers.contribution: CorreGen significantly improves clustering robustness on both synthetic and real-world noisy datasets.

papers.title: Adaptive Gaussian Expansion for On-the-fly Category Discovery
papers.contribution: AGE achieves state-of-the-art performance in on-the-fly category discovery across multiple datasets with significantly improved real-time classification feasibility.

papers.title: Asymmetric Multi-View Clustering with Hyperbolic Uncertainty Modeling
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on multi-view clustering through uncertainty-aware hyperbolic embeddings and confidence-based screening.

papers.title: BASIL: Scalable Bayesian Semi-supervised Clustering with Feature Selection and Adaptive Constraint Weighting
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive accuracy while reducing training time by over 96% on large datasets, learns interpretable cluster-specific feature importance, and remains robust to up to 30% noisy constraints.

papers.title: Beyond Independence: Learning Correlated Views for Variational Incomplete Multi-View Clustering
papers.contribution: In this paper, we propose a variational framework that explicitly goes beyond this assumption by introducing a learnable cross-view correlation structure.

papers.title: Bipartite Graph Attention-based Clustering for Large-scale scRNA-seq Data
papers.contribution: BGFormer achieves state-of-the-art clustering performance with linear complexity, demonstrating effectiveness and scalability on multiple large-scale scRNA-seq datasets.

papers.title: Confident Block Diagonal Structure-Aware Invariable Graph Completion for Incomplete Multi-view Clustering
papers.contribution: Demonstrates superior performance on multiple benchmark datasets compared to state-of-the-art incomplete multi-view clustering methods.

papers.title: Coordinated Disentanglement with Iterative Mode Discovery Under Hidden Correlations
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on disentanglement tasks by mitigating error amplification in iterative mode discovery.

papers.title: Debiased and Denoised Projection Learning for Incomplete Multi-view Clustering
papers.contribution: PDD achieves superior incomplete multi-view clustering performance compared to state-of-the-art methods while avoiding imputation overhead.

papers.title: Explainable $ K $-means Neural Networks for Multi-view Clustering
papers.contribution: Balances all four criteria while achieving effectiveness and efficiency superior to other multi-view clustering methods.

papers.title: Fine-to-Coarse Fairness-Informed Multi-View Clustering
papers.contribution: To be specific, we transfer anchor allocation to discrete sample-cluster learning via bipartite graph bridge, and then backpropagate cluster state consisting of size and dispersion degree to guide anchor assignment.

papers.title: Independent Component Discovery in Temporal Count Data
papers.contribution: Recovers mixing functions and latent sources across diverse settings, revealing co-variation patterns and regime shifts in microbiome and climate data.

papers.title: Information-Theoretic Disentangled Latent Modeling with Conditional Diffusion for Incomplete Multi-View Clustering
papers.contribution: Demonstrates superior clustering performance and robust missing-view generation compared to state-of-the-art methods.

papers.title: Mini-cluster Guided Long-tailed Deep Clustering
papers.contribution: Mitigates model bias through re-weighting gradients from different classes, demonstrating effectiveness on multiple imbalanced benchmarks.

papers.title: Mixing Configurations for Downstream Prediction
papers.contribution: Consistent improvements across tabular, molecular, vision, and text domains with particularly pronounced gains in low-data regimes.

papers.title: Multi-Condition Conformal Selection
papers.contribution: MCCS achieves rigorous FDR-controlled selection across various multi-condition environments with finite-sample theoretical guarantees.

papers.title: NeuralFLoC: Neural Flow-Based Joint Registration and Clustering of Functional Data
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art joint registration and clustering on functional benchmarks while establishing universal approximation guarantees and asymptotic consistency.

papers.title: Nonconvex Low-Rank Tensor Representation with Deep Priors for Multiview Subspace Clustering
papers.contribution: Develops efficient ADMM-based algorithm with convergence guarantees, demonstrating superiority over existing methods on various datasets.

papers.title: PRISM: Progressive Robust Learning for Open-World Continual Category Discovery
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms baselines on SSB-C and DomainNet benchmarks by addressing non-stationary open-world continual discovery.

papers.title: PartCo: Part-Level Correspondence Priors Enhance Category Discovery
papers.contribution: Part-level correspondence priors significantly improve existing GCD approaches across multiple benchmarks.

papers.title: Positive-Unlabeled Learning with Extreme Scarcity of Labeled Positives
papers.contribution: Significantly improves performance under extreme label scarcity on eight benchmarks by lowering sample threshold through dual regularization mechanisms.

papers.title: Relationship Alignment for View-aware Multi-view Clustering
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on multiple benchmarks by promoting cluster-level semantic consistency while preserving natural inter-view relationships.

papers.title: Smoothing Slot Attention Iterations and Recurrences
papers.contribution: Improves object discovery, recognition, and visual reasoning through smoothed slot attention across iterations and recurrences.

papers.title: Spatial Structure and Selective Text Jointly Facilitate Image Clustering
papers.contribution: SATC achieves effectiveness on 18 benchmark datasets, with textual feature selector demonstrating rationality through ablation studies.

papers.title: SpectralGCD: Spectral Concept Selection and Cross-modal Representation Learning for Generalized Category Discovery
papers.contribution: SpectralGCD achieves comparable or significantly superior accuracy to state-of-the-art methods at a fraction of computational cost across six benchmarks.

papers.title: Unified and Efficient Multi-view Clustering from Probabilistic Perspective
papers.contribution: Improves explanation ability of anchor-based multi-view clustering with efficient probabilistic framework.
